title: Windows Hopper keyboard shortcut does not work in Rider.
author: snarum
summary: Window Hopper shows no thumbnails for multiple JetBrains Rider windows on 0.101.2362 while working in other applications, but process/elevation details and logs are missing.

status.label: Needs Rider process diagnostics
status.detail: The Rider-only reproduction is clear, but process grouping, elevation, and window eligibility need one focused diagnostic capture.

next_action.label: Request Rider process diagnostics
next_action.reason: Capture Window Hopper logs and Rider process/elevation topology from the failed invocation.

judgment.rationale: This is a plausible 0.101 Window Hopper issue, but Window Hopper groups eligible windows by resolved process image, and the report does not establish Rider process topology, elevation, or eligibility failures.
evidence: PowerToys 0.101.2362 Window Hopper works in other applications but shows no thumbnails for multiple Rider windows.
The author tried multiple shortcuts, with the latest Shift+Ctrl+Alt+Page Down.
AltWindowCycle enumerates Alt-Tab-eligible windows and selects those with the same resolved foreground process image.
No diagnostic ZIP, Rider version, process topology, or elevation state was supplied.
judgment.recommended_action: Request /bugreport immediately after a failed Rider invocation plus Rider version, elevation, and whether windows share one rider64.exe process.

issue_context.summary: Window Hopper produces no thumbnails when invoked from JetBrains Rider despite working in other applications and with multiple shortcut choices.
known_information: The reproduction uses multiple Rider windows and PowerToys 0.101.2362 stable.
The failure is scoped to Rider.
The Needs-Author-Feedback label was removed after automated triage, leaving the issue for maintainer response.
inferences: Rider may present project windows through unusual process, owner, or elevation relationships, but this is unconfirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The code path depends on process identity and Alt-Tab eligibility. One fresh log capture and Task Manager observation decide whether maintainers need a Rider grouping rule, eligibility fix, or elevation guidance.
initial_investigation: src/modules/AltWindowCycle/AltWindowCycle.cpp enumerates windows, checks Alt-Tab eligibility, and records RealProcessImagePath only for eligible windows.
src/modules/AltWindowCycle/AltWindowCycleLogic.h::SelectCycleWindows selects windows whose process key matches the foreground process key.
Targeted search found no other Rider-specific Window Hopper duplicate or linked fix.

comment.body: Thanks for the clear Rider-only reproduction on PowerToys 0.101.2362 and confirmation that several shortcut choices work in other apps. Please invoke Window Hopper while a Rider window is foreground, then add a comment containing /bugreport immediately afterward. Also state Rider version exact version, whether Rider or PowerToys is elevated, and whether the open Rider windows belong to one Rider process or separate ider64.exe processes (Task Manager Details is sufficient). Those facts determine whether the failure is window eligibility, process grouping, or privilege-related.
